d: Short, sleek jet-black hair is styled in a low ponytail tied with a teal ribbon, featuring thick bangs that frame the face. Small, narrow golden eyes carry a neutral expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is petite and slender, dressed in a white short-sleeved kimono top tucked into a deep red pleated hakama skirt with a black waist belt. Signature details include a grey glove on the left hand and a large, grey mechanical flight deck piece worn as an accessory over the shoulder, accompanied by a small grey utility pouch.
